name: ide-ruby
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Ruby language intelligence through Ruby LSP.

rubyPath.title: Ruby Path
rubyPath.description: Path to the project's Ruby executable. Leave empty to use Ruby on PATH, including active version-manager shims.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Path to the Ruby ruby-lsp executable script (without .bat or .cmd). Leave empty to use the managed server, then the selected Ruby's gems.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show a notification when Ruby or Ruby LSP cannot be found, offering to install the server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose which language-server features the editor uses.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report syntax errors and configured linter problems.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show method parameters while entering a call.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find references to constants and supported symbols.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format documents, ranges and code entered while typing.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename constants and update their references.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer fixes and refactorings for the selected code.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Annotate implicit rescue classes and shorthand hash values.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Highlight source code using semantic information.

formatter.title: Formatter
formatter.description: Formatter used by Ruby LSP. Auto detects the project's RuboCop or Syntax Tree dependency; formatters must be in the project bundle.

linters.title: Linters
linters.description: Linter integrations from the project bundle. Leave empty for Ruby LSP's automatic detection; use rubocop_internal for its built-in RuboCop integration.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Which implicit Ruby constructs to annotate. Both are disabled by default, matching Ruby LSP.

implicitRescue.title: Implicit Rescue
implicitRescue.description: Show the implicit StandardError class on rescue clauses.

implicitHashValue.title: Implicit Hash Values
implicitHashValue.description: Show values omitted from shorthand hash entries.
